title: Exact conservative section transport of actual integral complexes
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme X in universe u, use the actual integral module category [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], the canonical point coefficient isomorphism [def-sfb-integral-constant-model-realization], and the scalar map and small-site section functor [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. Define the constant ring on the large site, its small section ring and residue map by these existing constructions. Define F to be the composite of derived restriction along the inverse point coefficient isomorphism, derived scalar restriction to constant integers, and the derived smallModules functor. Give the section equivalence and additive instance, prove F conservative using its exact homology comparisons, identify F(K) with the representative-based smallDerivedObject appearing in the target, and prove invariance of the local residue-kernel completeness predicate under isomorphism. All data are explicit, with no existentially selected new functor.
